narration: The same money, a different life. For {identical_months} months the two lives were one. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. At the layoff in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, more of the ghost's pay was still its own when each month opened, and its Freedom was {freedom_gap}. The ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
